Name: ch3_intro
Dialogue: Hari yang sama, lelah yang sama... dan upah yang bahkan tak cukup untuk hidup layak
EN: Same day, same exhaustion… and pay that’s not even enough for a decent life.

Name: ch3_welcome
Dialogue: Sampah ini… sudah menumpuk lagi.
EN: This trash… it’s piled up again.

Name: ch3_shock_0
Dialogue: Kosong...?!
EN: Empty…?!

Name: ch3_shock_1
Dialogue: Tapi… tadi jelas-jelas dari sini...
EN: But… I’m sure it came from here earlier…

Name: ch3_janitor
Dialogue: Lo ngapain anjirrr
EN: What the hell are you doing?

Name: ch3_tired_0
Dialogue: Dahlah cape bgt wkwk
EN: Forget it, I’m too tired for this…

Name: ch3_disturbed_by_basketball
Dialogue: Aku tidak bisa fokus kalau berisik
EN: I can’t focus when it’s noisy.

Name: ch3_basket1
Dialogue: Bola basket?
EN: A basketball?

Name: ch3_basket_2
Dialogue: Jam segini?
EN: At this hour?

Name: ch3_sepi
Dialogue: Sepi sekali. Tidak seperti biasanya...
EN: It’s so quiet. Not like usual…

Name: ch3_sepi2
Dialogue: mungkin semua orang sedang sibuk bahagia
EN: Maybe everyone’s busy being happy.

Name: ch3_basket2
Dialogue: Itu... bola lagi?
EN: That… again?

Name: ch3_basket2_2
Dialogue: Tapi tidak ada siapa pun di sini
EN: But there’s no one here.

Name: ch3_basket2_3
Dialogue: Apa aku mulai berhalusinasi?
EN: Am I starting to hallucinate?

Name: ch3_welcome_2
Dialogue: Aku bahkan tidak sempat membereskan hidupku sendiri, apalagi ruangan ini
EN: I can’t even get my own life in order, let alone this room.

Name: ch3_deadline
Dialogue: Selesai satu kekacauan... sekarang kembali ke kekacauan yang lain
EN: One mess done… straight into another mess.

Name: ch3_deadline_2
Dialogue: Deadline makin dekat, dan aku masih terjebak di awal
EN: The deadline’s getting closer, and I’m still stuck at the start.

Name: ch3_disturbed
Dialogue: Belum juga sempat duduk, sudah disambut suara bola lagi.
EN: I haven’t even sat down yet, and that ball is bouncing again.

Name: ch3_disturbed2
Dialogue: Apa dunia sedang hobi menguji kewarasanku malam ini?
EN: Is the world trying to test my sanity tonight?

Name: ch3_disturbed3
Dialogue: Kalau ini caranya, aku akan cari tahu, dan semoga saja bukan hal bodoh lagi.
EN: If that’s how it is, I’m going to find out—hopefully it’s not something stupid again.

Name: ch3_frommike
Dialogue: Suaranya dari kamar 208...? Itu kan kamarnya Michael
EN: The sound’s coming from room 208…? That’s Michael’s room.

Name: ch3_janiryan1
Dialogue: Sedang apa kamu di sini?
EN: What are you doing here?

Name: ch3_ryanjani1
Dialogue: Astaga, Pak! Bikin kaget saja...
EN: Whoa, sir! You scared me…

Name: ch3_janiryan2
Dialogue: Aku sudah memanggil dari tadi, tahu?
EN: I’ve been calling you for a while, you know?

Name: ch3_janiryan3
Dialogue: Kenapa? Kelihatan serius sekali. Kau mencari seseorang?
EN: What is it? You look so serious. Are you looking for someone?

Name: ch3_ryanjani3
Dialogue: Iya...keluarga yang tinggal di kamar ini ke mana, ya?
EN: Yeah… where’s the family who lives in this room?

Name: ch3_janiryan4
Dialogue: Kamar 208? Sudah lama kosong
EN: Room 208? It’s been empty for a long time.

Name: ch3_ryanjani4
Dialogue: Kosong?
EN: Empty?

Name: ch3_janiryan5
Dialogue: Yang terakhir tinggal di sini... ya kamu
EN: The last person who stayed here… was you.

Name: ch3_ryanjani6
Dialogue: (Yang benar saja)
EN: (You’ve gotta be kidding me.)

Name: ch3_ryanjani7
Dialogue: Tapi... ada pria, seumuran denganku. Katanya tinggal di sini
EN: But… there was a guy, about my age. He said he lived here.

Name: ch3_janiryan6
Dialogue: Aku tidak tahu soal itu
EN: I don’t know anything about that.

Name: ch3_ryanjani11
Dialogue: Baiklah kalau begitu. Maaf mengganggu
EN: Alright then. Sorry to bother you.

Name: ch3_questioning
Dialogue: Michael... Apa mungkin dia berbohong? Tapi untuk apa? Dia sendiri yang bilang tinggal di kamar 208
EN: Michael… could he have lied? But why? He’s the one who said he lives in room 208.

Name: ch3_questioning2
Dialogue: Tapi kamarnya kosong. Bahkan penjaga pun tidak tahu apa-apa
EN: Yet the room’s empty. Even the guard doesn’t know anything.

Name: ch3_questioning3
Dialogue: Dan sekarang... suara bola basket itu pun menghilang, seakan tak pernah ada
EN: And now… that basketball sound is gone, as if it never existed.

Name: ch3_questioning4
Dialogue: Aku tidak punya waktu untuk mengurai teka-teki ini. Tugas ini... harus segera kuselesaikan
EN: I don’t have time to untangle this mystery. This assignment… needs to get done.
